approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 PowerPC code into C++ with the ReXGlue SDK, whose runtime provides system services, graphics, audio and input.
notes: Native Windows x64 recompilation with a native Direct3D 12 renderer. Features 1x-4x resolution scaling, frame rates above the original 30 fps with interpolated frames, MSAA, FXAA, FidelityFX CAS and FSR, an FPS/frametime overlay, and a launcher and installer in seven languages. Players supply their own Xbox 360 game files.
